fact: The Lavushimanda district registration officer said digital civil registration, covering birth registration, runs on INRIS, which was deployed to 26 district national registration offices in March 2022 (Lusaka Times, 3 September 2026).
The same official said the exercise run on INRIS covers securing death certificates as well as birth registration (Lusaka Times, 3 September 2026).

INRIS, the civil registration and legal identity information management system, has been rolled out in 79 districts, covering all city and municipal councils, with some district councils pending, per the INRIS deputy project manager.

The Smart Zambia Institute issued a request for proposals on 3 December 2025, financed by IDA under the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project, to procure a system integrator for the CRVS core modules, backend infrastructure and enrolment kits.

The 2017 vital statistics report says birth notifications validated by district registrars are entered in the electronic civil register, with registered births of 104,816 in 2017 counted from the electronic database, and that births of 2013 and 2014 were largely on paper and not entered; health-facility notification was only starting in selected facilities.
The 2017 vital statistics report says birth and death notifications are entered in the district register and then in the electronic civil register, from which 2017 death statistics were produced.
The World Bank's WDI lists Zambia's completeness of birth registration at 14% for 2018, a national rate not tied to a digital system.

The Smart Zambia Institute procurement covers development, deployment and integration of civil registration and vital statistics core modules and enrolment kits, with full digital ID rollout targeted by the end of 2026.
system: civil registration and vital statistics core modules
